key_insight: NeuroForge turns the CFD physics residual into a reliable uncertainty signal for detecting prediction errors, while showing that the same residual is a poor direct correction target.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster CFD surrogates to self-audit their predictions and provide calibrated trust bands, which is valuable for safety-critical flow design and out-of-distribution deployment.
method: Compute the discretized steady-RANS residual of surrogate flow predictions.
Use split conformal calibration plus deep-ensemble uncertainty to form adaptive trust bands.
Train a supervised deep-equilibrium corrector to improve the predicted flow fields.
evidence_signal: Across three backbones and a second dataset, residual rank correlation with field error was consistently positive, conformal coverage matched the 0.90 target at 0.902±0.008, and the learned corrector reduced MSE on all three seeds.
watch_item: The correction gains are backbone-dependent, and the coverage guarantee only holds under exchangeability assumptions.
paper_title: NeuroForge: A Self-Correcting, Geometry-Native Neural CFD Engine with Calibrated Physics-Residual Trust
